-- Diplex Base Skin Changer | standalone visual-only executor script
-- Base assets and dropdown extracted from Pasted text(20260903-120908).txt.
-- Includes the supplied 1 of 1 base. No external script or model downloads.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
if env.DiplexBaseSkinController then pcall(env.DiplexBaseSkinController.Destroy) end
local alive, generation = true, 0
local nativeCleanup=function() end
local connections = {}
local function connect(signal, fn)
    local c = signal:Connect(fn)
    connections[#connections+1] = c
    return c
end
local function New(class, props)
    local obj = Instance.new(class)
    for k,v in pairs(props or {}) do obj[k] = v end
    return obj
end
local function Corner(obj, radius) return New("UICorner", {CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,radius),Parent=obj}) end
local function Stroke(obj,color,width,transparency)
    return New("UIStroke",{Color=color,Thickness=width,Transparency=transparency or 0,Parent=obj})
end
local BG, ACCENT = Color3.fromRGB(17,23,34), Color3.fromRGB(55,155,255)
local BTNGRN, BTNRED = Color3.fromRGB(30,115,215), Color3.fromRGB(60,74,95)
local gui = New("ScreenGui", {Name="DiplexBaseSkins",ResetOnSpawn=false,IgnoreGuiInset=false,DisplayOrder=90,ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling})
local parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
pcall(function() if gethui then parent=gethui() end end)
gui.Parent = parent
local surface=New("Frame",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,Parent=gui})
local function SetStatus(text,color)
    if alive then
        print("[Diplex Base Skins] "..text)
        if text:find("failed") or text:find("unavailable") then
            pcall(function() game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification",{Title="Base Skin",Text=text,Duration=4}) end)
        end
    end
end

local function GetPlayerPlot()
    if activePlot and activePlot.Parent then return activePlot end
    local plots=workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
    if not plots then return nil end
    for _,plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
        for _,key in ipairs({"Owner","OwnerId","OwnerID","OwnerUserId","UserId","UserID","Player","PlayerName","Username"}) do
            local v=plot:GetAttribute(key)
            local value=plot:FindFirstChild(key)
            if value and value:IsA("ValueBase") then v=value.Value end
            if v==LocalPlayer or tostring(v)==tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId) or v==LocalPlayer.Name then return plot end
        end
        local sign=plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign",true)
        if sign then
            for _,d in ipairs(sign:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("TextLabel") then
                    local t=d.Text:gsub("<.->","")
                    if t==LocalPlayer.Name.."'s Base" or t==LocalPlayer.DisplayName.."'s Base" or t==LocalPlayer.Name then return plot end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- Same proximity fallback as the source, restricted to a nearby plot.
    local root=LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local best,dist=nil,65
    if root then
        for _,plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
            local spawn=plot:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
            if spawn and spawn:IsA("BasePart") then
                local d=(spawn.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
                if d<dist then best=plot;dist=d end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

    -- saved state: { instance -> {kind = "beam"|"part", ...orig props...} }
    local _originalLaserState = {}
    local _activeLaserSkin = nil
    local _laserStreamConn = nil

    -- A part counts as "laser-related" if any ancestor or sibling-folder is named Laser/LaserHitbox,
    -- OR if its own name contains "Laser", OR if it visibly is a Beam.
    local function _isLaserLike(inst, plot)
        if inst:IsA("Beam") then return true end
        local nameHint = inst.Name and (inst.Name:lower():find("laser") ~= nil)
        if nameHint then return true end
        local p = inst.Parent
        while p and p ~= plot do
            local pname = p.Name
            if pname == "Laser" or pname == "LaserHitbox" then return true end
            -- also look at the parent's siblings: a "Laser" folder right next to us
            local pp = p.Parent
            if pp then
                if pp:FindFirstChild("Laser") or pp:FindFirstChild("LaserHitbox") then
                    -- only count if the part's own name hints at being part of the laser visual
                    if nameHint then return true end
                end
            end
            p = p.Parent
        end
        return false
    end

    local function _restoreLasers()
        if _laserStreamConn then pcall(function() _laserStreamConn:Disconnect() end); _laserStreamConn = nil end
        _activeLaserSkin = nil
        for inst, st in pairs(_originalLaserState) do
            if typeof(inst) == "Instance" and inst.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    if st.kind == "beam" then
                        inst.Color        = st.Color
                        inst.Transparency = st.Transparency
                    else
                        inst.Color        = st.Color
                        inst.Material     = st.Material
                        inst.Transparency = st.Transparency
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        _originalLaserState = {}
    end

    local function _isReddish(c)
        return c.R > 0.6 and c.G < 0.4 and c.B < 0.4
    end

    -- Skip anything inside these named ancestors — they're not lasers
    local LASER_BLOCKLIST_ANCESTORS = {
        Claim = true, CashPad = true, Multiplier = true, AnimalPodiums = true,
        DeliveryBox = true, FriendPanel = true, PlotSign = true, SkinPlotSign = true,
    }
    local function _hasBlockedAncestor(d, plot)
        local p = d.Parent
        while p and p ~= plot do
            if LASER_BLOCKLIST_ANCESTORS[p.Name] then return true end
            p = p.Parent
        end
        return false
    end
    -- Conversely: must be inside a Laser/LaserHitbox folder
    local function _hasLaserAncestor(d, plot)
        local p = d.Parent
        while p and p ~= plot do
            if p.Name == "Laser" or p.Name == "LaserHitbox" then return true end
            p = p.Parent
        end
        return false
    end

    -- Apply our laser look to a single newly-spotted part or beam
    local function _applyLaserLookTo(d, look)
        if _originalLaserState[d] then return end
        local plot = GetPlayerPlot()
        if not plot then return end
        if _hasBlockedAncestor(d, plot) then return end

        if d:IsA("Beam") then
            -- Only recolor Beams whose host is laser-related
            local host = d.Parent
            local hostIsLaser = false
            if host then
                local lower = host.Name:lower()
                hostIsLaser = (lower:find("laser") ~= nil)
                    or lower:find("structure base home") ~= nil
                    or _hasLaserAncestor(host, plot)
            end
            if not hostIsLaser then return end
            _originalLaserState[d] = { kind = "beam", Color = d.Color, Transparency = d.Transparency }
            pcall(function()
                d.Color        = look.beamColor
                d.Transparency = look.beamTransparency
            end)
        elseif d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Name ~= "LaserHitbox" and d.Transparency < 1 then
            local lower = d.Name:lower()
            local nameLooksLaser = lower:find("laser") ~= nil
                or lower:find("structure base home") ~= nil
            local underLaser = _hasLaserAncestor(d, plot)
            -- Strict: must be inside a Laser folder OR have a laser-like name.
            -- Reddish-only parts are NOT recolored (cashpad/etc. would be blue otherwise).
            if nameLooksLaser or underLaser then
                _originalLaserState[d] = {
                    kind = "part",
                    Color = d.Color, Material = d.Material, Transparency = d.Transparency,
                }
                pcall(function()
                    d.Color        = look.partColor
                    d.Material     = look.partMaterial
                    d.Transparency = look.partTransparency
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    local function _recolorLasersForSkin(skinName)
        _restoreLasers()
        if _laserStreamConn then pcall(function() _laserStreamConn:Disconnect() end); _laserStreamConn = nil end
        _activeLaserSkin = skinName
        local look = LASER_LOOKS[skinName]
        if not look then return end
        local plot = GetPlayerPlot()
        if not plot then return end

        -- Listen for new descendants that stream in while this skin is active
        _laserStreamConn = plot.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
            if _activeLaserSkin ~= skinName then return end
            local cur = LASER_LOOKS[_activeLaserSkin]
            if not cur then return end
            if d:IsA("Beam") or d:IsA("BasePart") then
                -- defer one frame so part properties are populated
                task.defer(function() _applyLaserLookTo(d, cur) end)
            end
        end)

        -- Initial pass: recolor everything that's already streamed in
        for _, d in plot:GetDescendants() do
            _applyLaserLookTo(d, look)
        end

        -- Safety re-scans in case more parts stream in late
        for _, t in ipairs({0.5, 1.5, 3.0, 6.0}) do
            task.delay(t, function()
                if _activeLaserSkin ~= skinName then return end
                local p = GetPlayerPlot()
                if not p then return end
                local cur = LASER_LOOKS[_activeLaserSkin]
                if not cur then return end
                for _, d in p:GetDescendants() do
                    _applyLaserLookTo(d, cur)
                end
            end)
        end
    end


-- White gate bars apply only to Phantom. Other skins keep the live gate appearance.
LASER_LOOKS={Phantom=LASER_LOOKS.Phantom}

-- Original Ruby CC visual-base hiding method. Keep the real plot's
-- collision geometry; the replacement model is appearance-only.
local neverHide = {
    Spawn=true, MainRoot=true, Hitbox=true,
    AnimalPodiums=true, Claim=true, Multiplier=true,
    DeliveryBox=true, DeliveryHitbox=true, CollectZone=true,
    Laser=true, LaserHitbox=true, StealHitbox=true,
    PlotBlock=true, FriendPanel=true, CashPad=true,
    FirstFloor=true, SecondFloor=true, ThirdFloor=true,
}

local function isInsideProtected(obj, plot)
    local p = obj.Parent
    while p and p ~= plot do
        if neverHide[p.Name] then return true end
        if p:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return true end
        if p:GetAttribute("Animal") or p:GetAttribute("Mutation") then return true end
        p = p.Parent
    end
    return false
end

local function shouldHidePlotPart(obj,plot)
    return obj:IsA("BasePart")
        and not neverHide[obj.Name]
        and not obj:GetAttribute("IgnoreColor")
        and not isInsideProtected(obj,plot)
        and obj.Transparency<1
end
local function hidePart(obj,plot)
    if not obj:IsDescendantOf(plot) or not shouldHidePlotPart(obj,plot) then return end
    -- Repeated streaming events must not overwrite the pre-skin value with 1.
    if hidden[obj]==nil then hidden[obj]=obj.LocalTransparencyModifier end
    obj.LocalTransparencyModifier=1
end
local function reconcileHiddenParts(plot)
    for obj,value in pairs(hidden) do
        if not obj.Parent or not obj:IsDescendantOf(plot) or not shouldHidePlotPart(obj,plot) then
            if obj.Parent then obj.LocalTransparencyModifier=value end
            hidden[obj]=nil
        end
    end
end
local function restore()
    if animationConnection then animationConnection:Disconnect();animationConnection=nil end
    for _,track in ipairs(tracks) do pcall(function() track:Stop();track:Destroy() end) end
    tracks={};activeName=nil
    _restoreLasers()
    if plotConnection then plotConnection:Disconnect();plotConnection=nil end
    if active then active:Destroy();active=nil end
    for d,v in pairs(hidden) do if d.Parent then pcall(function() d.LocalTransparencyModifier=v end) end end
    hidden={};activePlot=nil
end
local function removeSkin()
    generation=generation+1;restore();_selectedSkin=nil
    onSkinChanged(nil)
    SetStatus("Original base restored",Color3.fromRGB(163,191,219))
end
local function decode64(chunks)
    local chars="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    local lookup={};for i=1,#chars do lookup[chars:byte(i)]=i-1 end
    local s=table.concat(chunks);local out={}
    for i=1,#s,4 do
        local c,d=s:byte(i+2),s:byte(i+3)
        local v=(lookup[s:byte(i)] or 0)*262144+(lookup[s:byte(i+1)] or 0)*4096+(lookup[c] or 0)*64+(lookup[d] or 0)
        out[#out+1]=string.char(math.floor(v/65536)%256)
        if c~=61 then out[#out+1]=string.char(math.floor(v/256)%256) end
        if d~=61 then out[#out+1]=string.char(v%256) end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end
local function loadTemplate(name)
    if cache[name] then return cache[name] end
    local entry=assert(EMBEDDED_SKIN_MODELS[name],"Missing embedded model")
    assert(type(writefile)=="function","Executor needs writefile and local model loading")
    local path="Diplex_"..entry.file
    -- Always write the embedded bytes, so stale executor files cannot replace the model.
    local bytes=decode64(entry.chunks);assert(#bytes==entry.size,"Model size check failed")
    writefile(path,bytes)
    local objects
    for _,loader in ipairs({getcustomasset or false,getsynasset or false}) do
        if type(loader)=="function" then
            pcall(function() objects=game:GetObjects(loader(path)) end)
            if objects and #objects>0 then break end
        end
    end
    if not objects or #objects==0 then pcall(function() objects=game:GetObjects("rbxasset://"..path) end) end
    assert(objects and #objects>0,"Executor cannot load local RBXM models")
    local container=Instance.new("Folder");container.Name=name
    for _,obj in ipairs(objects) do
        for _,d in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
                -- Animation assets were stored under scripts in the saved models.
                for _,child in ipairs(d:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("Animation") then child.Parent=d.Parent end
                end
                d:Destroy()
            elseif d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or d:IsA("ClickDetector") then d:Destroy() end
        end
        if not obj:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then obj.Parent=container else obj:Destroy() end
    end
    if not alive then container:Destroy();error("Panel unloaded") end
    if cache[name] then container:Destroy();return cache[name] end
    cache[name]=container
    return container
end
local function chooseModel(container)
    local outer=container:GetChildren()[1]
    assert(outer,"Empty base model")
    local outerRoot=outer:FindFirstChild("MainRoot") or outer:FindFirstChild("Root") or outer:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
    local sourceCF=outerRoot and outerRoot:IsA("BasePart") and outerRoot.CFrame
    local skin=outer:FindFirstChild("Skin")
    local model=outer
    if skin and skin:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true) then
        local stats=LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
        local rebirths=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Rebirths")
        local n=rebirths and tonumber(rebirths.Value) or 0
        local floor=n>=10 and "ThirdFloor" or n>=2 and "SecondFloor" or "FirstFloor"
        model=skin:FindFirstChild(floor) or skin:FindFirstChild("ThirdFloor") or skin:FindFirstChild("SecondFloor") or skin:FindFirstChild("FirstFloor")
        -- Loose decorations (Valentines) need the complete supporting building.
        if not model then model=outer end
    end
    -- These saved Skin folders are ornaments, not complete buildings.
    if container.Name=="Aquatic" or container.Name=="Halloween" or container.Name=="Radioactive"
        or container.Name=="Strawberry" or container.Name=="Skibidi" then model=outer end
    local localRoot=model:FindFirstChild("Root") or model:FindFirstChild("MainRoot")
    if not sourceCF and localRoot and localRoot:IsA("BasePart") then sourceCF=localRoot.CFrame end
    assert(sourceCF,"No alignment root in saved model")
    return model,sourceCF,outer
end
local function startAnimations(clone,name)
    local statue=clone:FindFirstChild("Headless Statue",true)
    local motor=statue and statue:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Motor6D",true)
    local pumpkin=statue and statue:FindFirstChild("Pumpkin")
    if name=="Headless" and motor and motor.Part0 and motor.Part1 and pumpkin then
        local moving=motor.Part1
        local pieces={}
        for _,part in ipairs(pumpkin:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then pieces[part]=moving.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame) end
        end
        pieces[moving]=CFrame.new()
        -- Move the shell AND the separate glowing face by the same rigid transform.
        animationConnection=game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not motor.Part0 or not moving.Parent then return end
            local pose=motor.Part0.CFrame*motor.C0*CFrame.new(0,math.sin(workspace:GetServerTimeNow()*3),0)*motor.C1:Inverse()
            for part,offset in pairs(pieces) do if part.Parent then part.CFrame=pose*offset end end
        end)
    end
    local warnings={}
    for _,a in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
        if a:IsA("Animation") and a.AnimationId~="" then
            local scope=a.Parent
            local controller
            while scope and scope~=clone.Parent do
                controller=scope:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController") or scope:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if controller then break end
                scope=scope.Parent
            end
            if controller then
                local animator=controller:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator",controller)
                -- Motor-driven pieces must be free to move relative to their anchored rig root.
                for _,joint in ipairs(scope:GetDescendants()) do
                    if joint:IsA("Motor6D") and joint.Part0 and joint.Part1 then
                        joint.Part1.Anchored=false;joint.Part1.Massless=true
                    end
                end
                local ok,track=pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(a) end)
                if ok then
                    track.Looped=true;track:Play();tracks[#tracks+1]=track
                else warnings[#warnings+1]="Animation unavailable" end
            end
        end
    end
    return #warnings
end
local function applySkin(name,container)
    local plot=GetPlayerPlot();assert(plot,"Stand near your own base, then select the skin again")
    local target=plot:FindFirstChild("MainRoot") or plot:FindFirstChild("Root") or plot:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
    assert(target and target:IsA("BasePart"),"Plot root is not loaded yet")
    local template,sourceCF,outer=chooseModel(container)
    local clone=template:Clone();clone.Name="Diplex_ActiveBaseSkin"
    if template~=outer then
        -- Saved skins replace the shell; the exported plot keeps its support geometry
        -- beside Skin. Include those real parts before hiding the live building.
        for _,support in ipairs(outer:GetChildren()) do
            if support.Name=="Model" or support.Name=="Slope" then
                support:Clone().Parent=clone
            elseif support.Name=="PlotSign" and not clone:FindFirstChild("PlotSign",true) then
                support:Clone().Parent=clone
            end
        end
    end
    if name=="Aquatic" or name=="Halloween" or name=="Radioactive" then
        -- Only the exported Skin subtree is decorative for these three skins.
        -- Keep the outer building/floors solid, with no decorative collision cooking.
        local ornaments=clone:FindFirstChild("Skin")
        if ornaments then
            for _,part in ipairs(ornaments:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then part:SetAttribute("DiplexNoCollision",true) end
            end
        end
    end
    if name=="Headless" then
        for _,part in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and not part.CanCollide then
                -- Includes the exported cloth/flags whose mesh names are only Cube.*.
                part:SetAttribute("DiplexNoCollision",true)
            end
        end
    end
    -- Decorative PlotSign parts do not include the live owner's SurfaceGui.
    local replacementSign=clone:FindFirstChild("PlotSign",true) or clone:FindFirstChild("SkinPlotSign",true)
    local liveSign=plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
    if replacementSign and replacementSign:IsA("BasePart") and liveSign then
        for _,g in ipairs(liveSign:GetChildren()) do
            if g:IsA("LayerCollector") and not replacementSign:FindFirstChild(g.Name) then
                local copy=g:Clone();pcall(function() copy.Adornee=replacementSign end);copy.Enabled=true;copy.Parent=replacementSign
            end
        end
    end
    local count=0
    local ok,err=pcall(function()
        -- Remove gameplay containers at their boundary, keeping signs and decorative rigs.
        local remove={AnimalPodiums=true,Claim=true,Multiplier=true,DeliveryBox=true,DeliveryHitbox=true,CollectZone=true,Laser=true,LaserHitbox=true,StealHitbox=true,PlotBlock=true,FriendPanel=true,CashPad=true,Spawn=true,AnimalTarget=true,InvisibleWalls=true,Purchases=true,Unlock=true}
        for _,d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsDescendantOf(clone) and (remove[d.Name] or d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or d:IsA("ClickDetector") or d:IsA("PathfindingModifier")) then d:Destroy() end
        end
        local delta=target.CFrame*sourceCF:Inverse()
        for _,d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                count=count+1;d.Anchored=true;d.CollisionGroup="Default";d.CanCollide=false;d.CanQuery=false;d.CanTouch=false;d.CFrame=delta*d.CFrame
                if d.Name=="Root" or d.Name=="MainRoot" then d.Transparency=1 end
            elseif d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") then
                local text=d.Text
                if text:find("{playerName}",1,true) or text:lower():find("'s base",1,true) or text=="Empty Base" then
                    d.Text=LocalPlayer.DisplayName.."'s Base"
                elseif text:lower():find("ruby",1,true) then d.Text="Diplex" end
            end
        end
        assert(count>0,"This skin contains no visible geometry")
    end)
    if not ok then clone:Destroy();error(err) end
    restore()
    clone.Parent=workspace;active=clone;activePlot=plot
    for _,d in ipairs(plot:GetDescendants()) do hidePart(d,plot) end
    plotConnection=plot.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
        task.defer(function()
            if alive and active==clone and d:IsDescendantOf(plot) then
                hidePart(d,plot)
                -- Apply the original protection rule if a Humanoid streams late.
                if d:IsA("Humanoid") then
                    reconcileHiddenParts(plot)
                end
            end
        end)
    end)
    _selectedSkin=name;activeName=name
    _recolorLasersForSkin(name)
    local animationOK,animationErrors=pcall(startAnimations,clone,name)
    onSkinChanged(name)
    SetStatus("Applied: "..name..((not animationOK or animationErrors>0) and " • animation asset unavailable" or " • client-side"),Color3.fromRGB(102,224,165))
end
local function loadSkinModels(callback,name)
    generation=generation+1;local ticket=generation
    if activeName==name and active and active.Parent then return end
    SetStatus("Loading "..name.."…")
    task.spawn(function()
        local job=loadingTemplates[name]
        if not job then
            job={done=false};loadingTemplates[name]=job
            job.ok,job.result=pcall(loadTemplate,name)
            job.done=true;loadingTemplates[name]=nil
        else
            repeat task.wait() until job.done or not alive or ticket~=generation
        end
        local ok,result=job.ok,job.result
        if not alive or ticket~=generation then return end
        if ok then ok,result=pcall(callback,result) end
        if not ok then _selectedSkin=activeName;onSkinChanged(activeName);SetStatus(tostring(result):gsub("^.-:%d+: ",""),Color3.fromRGB(255,142,142)) end
    end)
end

-- Preserve live option artwork where available; retain the existing skin list.
local function makeSkinOption(name,parent,order,height,zindex)
    local pg=LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    local original=pg
    for _,key in ipairs({"Settings","Settings","Content","ScrollingFrame","Base Skin","Button","DropDown"}) do
        original=original and original:FindFirstChild(key)
    end
    local exact=original and original:FindFirstChild(name)
    if exact and not exact:IsA("GuiButton") then exact=nil end
    local template=exact or (original and (original:FindFirstChild("Normal") or original:FindFirstChild("Candy")))
    local colors=SKIN_COLORS[name] or {main=Color3.fromRGB(125,111,111),stroke=Color3.fromRGB(80,70,70)}
    local row=template and template:IsA("GuiButton") and template:Clone() or Instance.new("ImageButton")
    row.Name=name;row.Size=UDim2.new(.831,0,0,height);row.Position=UDim2.new();row.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new()
    row.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.None;row.LayoutOrder=order;row.Visible=true;row.Active=true
    if not exact then row.BackgroundColor3=colors.main;row.BackgroundTransparency=0 end
    row.BorderSizePixel=0;row.AutoButtonColor=false;row.ZIndex=zindex
    if row:IsA("ImageButton") then row.ImageTransparency=1 else row.Text="" end
    for _,d in ipairs(row:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d.Name=="Locked" or d.Name=="DropDown" or d:IsA("UIAspectRatioConstraint") or d:IsA("UISizeConstraint") or d:IsA("UIScale") then
            d:Destroy()
        elseif d:IsA("GuiObject") then d.ZIndex=zindex+1 end
        if not exact and d.Parent and (d:IsA("UIGradient") or d.Name=="ShineSweep") then d:Destroy() end
    end
    local label=row:FindFirstChild("Text")
    if not label or not label:IsA("TextLabel") then
        label=New("TextLabel",{Name="Text",BackgroundTransparency=1,Parent=row})
    end
    if not exact then
        label.Text=name;label.RichText=false
        label.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5);label.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5)
        label.Size=UDim2.fromScale(.849,.591)
        label.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
        label.FontFace=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json",Enum.FontWeight.ExtraBold)
        label.TextScaled=true;label.TextWrapped=true
    end
    label.ZIndex=zindex+1
    local limit=label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UITextSizeConstraint") or New("UITextSizeConstraint",{Parent=label})
    if not exact then limit.MinTextSize=1;limit.MaxTextSize=67 end
    local edge=row:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke") or Stroke(row,colors.stroke,1.4370369911193848,0)
    local outline=label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke") or Stroke(label,colors.stroke,1.0777777433395386,0)
    if not exact then
        edge.Color=colors.stroke;outline.Color=colors.stroke
        if name=="Phantom" then
            -- Appearance explicitly supplied in the GUI export.
            row.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
            edge.Color=Color3.new(0,0,0);outline.Color=Color3.new(0,0,0)
            label.RichText=true;label.Text="<b>Phantom</b>"
        end
    end
    local check=New("TextLabel",{Name="DiplexEquippedCheck",Text="✓",Visible=false,
        BackgroundTransparency=1,AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,1),Position=UDim2.new(1,-3,1,-2),
        Size=UDim2.fromOffset(14,14),Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold,TextSize=13,
        TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),ZIndex=zindex+2,Parent=row})
    Stroke(check,Color3.new(0,0,0),1,0)
    animateButton(row)
    row.Parent=parent
    return row
end

-- Ruby CC expanded Settings.CanvasSize for its injected base-skin choices.
-- Keep the complete list in that same scrolling space, and restore on close.
local function restoreSettingsCanvas()
    if not canvasState then return end
    local saved=canvasState;canvasState=nil
    local scroller=saved.scroller
    -- Restore the canvas before putting relative measurements back. Keeping
    -- automatic sizing paused avoids a transient oversized layout on close.
    if scroller.Parent then scroller.CanvasSize=saved.size end
    for row,size in pairs(saved.rowSizes) do
        if row.Parent then row.Size=size end
    end
    for object,properties in pairs(saved.layoutProperties) do
        if object.Parent then
            for property,value in pairs(properties) do object[property]=value end
        end
    end
    if scroller.Parent then
        scroller.AutomaticCanvasSize=saved.automatic
        scroller.CanvasPosition=saved.position
    end
end
local function setPopupOpen(open)
    if not popup then return end
    popup.Visible=open
    if nativeArrow then nativeArrow.Rotation=open and 180 or 0 end
    if open then
        if setSelection then setSelection() end
        if updatePopupLayout then updatePopupLayout() end
    else
        restoreSettingsCanvas()
    end
end
local function closePopup() setPopupOpen(false) end
local function disconnectNative()
    restoreSettingsCanvas()
    for _,c in ipairs(nativeConnections) do c:Disconnect() end;nativeConnections={}
    if nativeButton then nativeButton:Destroy();nativeButton=nil end
    if popup then popup:Destroy();popup=nil end
    if nativeHost then nativeHost:Destroy();nativeHost=nil end
    if nativeOriginal and nativeOriginal.Parent then nativeOriginal.Visible=nativeWasVisible end
    nativeOriginal=nil;nativeText=nil;nativeArrow=nil;nativeRows={};lastRowHeight=nil;nativeScroller=nil;displayedSkin=nil;displayedSource=nil
end
nativeCleanup=disconnectNative
local function bindNative(signal,fn)
    nativeConnections[#nativeConnections+1]=signal:Connect(fn)
end
-- One tween per control: rapid pointer changes cancel the previous transition.
animateButton=function(button)
    local scale=New("UIScale",{Name="DiplexInteractionScale",Scale=1,Parent=button})
    local hovered,focused,pressed=false,false,false
    local tween
    local function refresh()
        if tween then tween:Cancel() end
        tween=TweenService:Create(scale,TweenInfo.new(pressed and .08 or .14,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {Scale=pressed and .97 or ((hovered or focused) and 1.035 or 1)})
        tween:Play()
    end
    local function reset()
        hovered=false;focused=false;pressed=false;refresh()
    end
    bindNative(button.MouseEnter,function() hovered=true;refresh() end)
    bindNative(button.MouseLeave,function() hovered=false;pressed=false;refresh() end)
    bindNative(button.SelectionGained,function() focused=true;refresh() end)
    bindNative(button.SelectionLost,reset)
    local heldInput
    bindNative(button.InputBegan,function(input)
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            or input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA then
            heldInput=input;pressed=true;refresh()
        end
    end)
    bindNative(UIS.InputEnded,function(input)
        if input==heldInput or (heldInput and input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
            heldInput=nil;pressed=false;refresh()
        end
    end)
    bindNative(UIS.WindowFocusReleased,reset)
    bindNative(button:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"),function() if not button.Visible then reset() end end)
    bindNative(button.Destroying,function() if tween then tween:Cancel() end end)
end
-- The applied model wins over the game's label only while it really exists.
-- Never treat a click or a pending/failed load as an equipped skin.
local function resolveEquippedSkin()
    if activeName and active and active.Parent and activePlot and activePlot.Parent then
        return activeName,"visual"
    end
    local label=nativeOriginal and nativeOriginal:FindFirstChild("Text")
    if label and label:IsA("TextLabel") then
        local name=label.Text:gsub("<.->",""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if name~="" then return name,"native" end
    end
    return "Normal","default"
end
local function copyGradients(source,target)
    for _,child in ipairs(target:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("UIGradient") and child.Name=="DiplexSelectedGradient" then child:Destroy() end
    end
    if source then
        for _,child in ipairs(source:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("UIGradient") then
                local copy=child:Clone();copy.Name="DiplexSelectedGradient";copy.Parent=target
            end
        end
    end
end
setSelection=function(force)
    if not nativeButton or not nativeText then return end
    local name,origin=resolveEquippedSkin()
    if not force and displayedSkin==name and displayedSource==origin then return end
    displayedSkin=name;displayedSource=origin
    local appearance=nil
    for _,row in ipairs(nativeRows) do
        local equipped=row.Name==name
        row:SetAttribute("Equipped",equipped)
        local check=row:FindFirstChild("DiplexEquippedCheck")
        if check then check.Visible=equipped end
        if equipped then appearance=row end
    end
    -- Some game-owned skins may not be in the embedded visual skin list.
    if not appearance and origin=="native" then appearance=nativeOriginal end
    local colors=SKIN_COLORS[name]
    nativeButton.BackgroundColor3=appearance and appearance.BackgroundColor3
        or (colors and colors.main or Color3.fromRGB(125,111,111))
    nativeButton.BackgroundTransparency=appearance and appearance.BackgroundTransparency or 0
    nativeButton:SetAttribute("EquippedSkin",name)
    local label=appearance and appearance:FindFirstChild("Text")
    nativeText.RichText=label and label.RichText or false
    nativeText.Text=label and label.Text or name
    nativeText.TextColor3=label and label.TextColor3 or Color3.new(1,1,1)
    nativeText.TextTransparency=label and label.TextTransparency or 0
    if label then nativeText.FontFace=label.FontFace end
    local edge=nativeButton:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    local sourceEdge=appearance and appearance:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if edge then edge.Color=sourceEdge and sourceEdge.Color or Color3.fromRGB(125,111,111) end
    local textEdge=nativeText:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    local sourceTextEdge=label and label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if textEdge then
        textEdge.Color=sourceTextEdge and sourceTextEdge.Color or Color3.fromRGB(103,91,91)
        textEdge.Transparency=sourceTextEdge and sourceTextEdge.Transparency or 0
    end
    copyGradients(appearance,nativeButton)
    copyGradients(label,nativeText)
    -- Position, size, text bounds, and the reversed triangle stay untouched.
end
onSkinChanged=function() setSelection(true) end
local function selectNative(name)
    if os.clock()<suppressSkinActivationUntil then return end
    closePopup()
    if name=="Normal" then removeSkin();return end
    loadSkinModels(function(folder) if folder then applySkin(name,folder) end end,name)
end
local function locateNative()
    local o=LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    for _,key in ipairs({"Settings","Settings","Content","ScrollingFrame","Base Skin","Button"}) do
        o=o and o:FindFirstChild(key)
    end
    return o
end
local function visibleThroughParents(o)
    local node=o
    while node and node~=game do
        if node:IsA("GuiObject") and not node.Visible then return false end
        if node:IsA("LayerCollector") and not node.Enabled then return false end
        node=node.Parent
    end
    return true
end
local function nativeScale(node)
    local scale=1
    while node and node~=game do
        for _,child in ipairs(node:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("UIScale") then scale=scale*child.Scale end
        end
        node=node.Parent
    end
    return math.max(.01,scale)
end

-- The list has its full content height; only the Settings viewport clips it.
local function dropdownLayout(x,y,w,h,rowCount,scale)
    local width=w*1.221
    local rowHeight=h/scale
    local height=(24+rowCount*rowHeight+math.max(0,rowCount-1)*8)*scale
    return x+(w-width)*.5,y+h*1.2,width,height,rowHeight
end

-- Use the rendered gap before expansion: it includes scale padding and any
-- flex-distributed space, so the existing Settings appearance is retained.
local function measuredRowGap(rows,scale,fallback)
    table.sort(rows,function(a,b) return a.y<b.y end)
    local gap=nil
    for i=2,#rows do
        local distance=(rows[i].y-rows[i-1].y-rows[i-1].height)/scale
        if distance>=0 then gap=gap and math.min(gap,distance) or distance end
    end
    return gap or fallback
end
local function expandSettingsCanvas(scale)
    if canvasState then return end
    local scroller=nativeScroller
    local baseHeight=scroller.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y/scale
    local saved={scroller=scroller,size=scroller.CanvasSize,
        automatic=scroller.AutomaticCanvasSize,position=scroller.CanvasPosition,
        baseHeight=baseHeight,rowSizes={},layoutProperties={}}
    local rows,changes={},{}
    local function freeze(object,property,value)
        local original=saved.layoutProperties[object] or {}
        saved.layoutProperties[object]=original
        original[property]=object[property]
        changes[#changes+1]={object=object,property=property,value=value}
    end
    -- Read every measurement first; mutating a row while automatic sizing is
    -- still enabled can otherwise change the measurements of the next row.
    for _,row in ipairs(scroller:GetChildren()) do
        if row:IsA("GuiObject") then
            if row.Visible then
                rows[#rows+1]={y=row.AbsolutePosition.Y,height=row.AbsoluteSize.Y}
            end
            if row.Size.Y.Scale~=0 then
                saved.rowSizes[row]=row.Size
                changes[#changes+1]={object=row,property="Size",
                    value=UDim2.new(row.Size.X.Scale,row.Size.X.Offset,0,row.AbsoluteSize.Y/scale)}
            end
        end
    end
    for _,object in ipairs(scroller:GetChildren()) do
        if object:IsA("UIListLayout") and object.FillDirection==Enum.FillDirection.Vertical then
            local padding=object.Padding
            local gap=measuredRowGap(rows,scale,padding.Scale*baseHeight+padding.Offset)
            freeze(object,"Padding",UDim.new(0,gap))
            freeze(object,"VerticalFlex",Enum.UIFlexAlignment.None)
            freeze(object,"VerticalAlignment",Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top)
        elseif object:IsA("UIPadding") then
            for _,property in ipairs({"PaddingTop","PaddingBottom"}) do
                local padding=object[property]
                if padding.Scale~=0 then
                    freeze(object,property,UDim.new(0,padding.Scale*baseHeight+padding.Offset))
                end
            end
        end
    end
    canvasState=saved
    scroller.AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.None
    for _,change in ipairs(changes) do change.object[change.property]=change.value end
end

updatePopupLayout=function()
    if not popup or not popup.Visible or not nativeButton or not nativeHost or not nativeScroller then return end
    if not nativeScroller.Parent or not nativeButton.Parent or not visibleThroughParents(nativeButton) then
        closePopup();return
    end
    local content=nativeHost.Parent
    local contentSize=content.AbsoluteSize
    local viewport=nativeScroller.AbsoluteWindowSize
    if contentSize.X<=0 or contentSize.Y<=0 or viewport.X<=0 or viewport.Y<=0 then return end
    -- Overlay exactly the Settings scrolling viewport, below its fixed header.
    local viewportPos=nativeScroller.AbsolutePosition-content.AbsolutePosition
    nativeHost.Position=UDim2.fromScale(viewportPos.X/contentSize.X,viewportPos.Y/contentSize.Y)
    nativeHost.Size=UDim2.fromScale(viewport.X/contentSize.X,viewport.Y/contentSize.Y)
    local scale=nativeScale(nativeScroller)
    expandSettingsCanvas(scale)
    local pos=nativeButton.AbsolutePosition-nativeScroller.AbsolutePosition
    local size=nativeButton.AbsoluteSize
    local x,y,w,h,rowHeight=dropdownLayout(pos.X,pos.Y,size.X,size.Y,#nativeRows,scale)
    popup.Size=UDim2.fromScale(w/viewport.X,h/viewport.Y)
    popup.Position=UDim2.fromScale(x/viewport.X,y/viewport.Y)
    if rowHeight~=lastRowHeight then
        lastRowHeight=rowHeight
        for _,row in ipairs(nativeRows) do row.Size=UDim2.new(.831,0,0,rowHeight) end
    end
    -- CanvasPosition and the other Absolute properties are rendered pixels.
    -- Adding the scroll offset keeps the list's bottom fixed in canvas space,
    -- even after the opener has scrolled above the visible window.
    local bottom=(nativeScroller.CanvasPosition.Y+y+h)/scale+8
    local height=math.max(canvasState.baseHeight,bottom)
    local saved=canvasState.size
    local wanted=UDim2.new(saved.X.Scale,saved.X.Offset,0,math.ceil(height))
    if nativeScroller.CanvasSize~=wanted then nativeScroller.CanvasSize=wanted end
end
local function installNative(original)
    disconnectNative()
    nativeOriginal=original;nativeWasVisible=original.Visible
    local clone,label,arrow=buildSuppliedSelector(original.Parent)
    clone.Name="DiplexBaseSkinButton"
    clone.ZIndex=original.ZIndex+1
    clone.AutoButtonColor=false
    nativeButton=clone;nativeText=label;nativeArrow=arrow
    for _,d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("GuiObject") then d.ZIndex=clone.ZIndex+1 end
    end
    -- The opener stays the exact supplied size, including on hover and press.
    local scroller=original.Parent.Parent
    assert(scroller:IsA("ScrollingFrame"),"Settings scrolling frame unavailable")
    nativeScroller=scroller
    local content=scroller.Parent
    nativeHost=New("Frame",{Name="DiplexBaseSkinViewport",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),
        Position=UDim2.new(),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,
        ClipsDescendants=true,Active=false,ZIndex=200,Parent=content})
    original.Visible=false
    bindNative(original:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"),function() if original.Visible then original.Visible=false end end)
    popup=New("Frame",{Name="DiplexSettingsSkins",Size=UDim2.fromOffset(190,300),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0),BackgroundTransparency=.5,BorderSizePixel=0,Active=false,ClipsDescendants=false,Visible=false,ZIndex=200,Parent=nativeHost})
    New("UIListLayout",{SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,Padding=UDim.new(0,8),HorizontalAlignment=Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,Parent=popup})
    New("UIPadding",{PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,16),PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,8),Parent=popup})
    local names={"Normal"};for _,entry in ipairs(SKINS) do names[#names+1]=entry.name end
    for i,name in ipairs(names) do
        local row=makeSkinOption(name,popup,i,60,201)
        nativeRows[#nativeRows+1]=row
        bindNative(row.Activated,function() selectNative(name) end)
    end
    bindNative(clone.Activated,function()
        setPopupOpen(not popup.Visible)
    end)
    local function scrollSettings(delta)
        if not popup or not popup.Visible then return end
        local maxY=math.max(0,scroller.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y-scroller.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y)
        scroller.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(scroller.CanvasPosition.X,
            math.clamp(scroller.CanvasPosition.Y+delta,0,maxY))
        updatePopupLayout()
    end
    -- Popup is an overlay, so explicitly route wheel/touch scrolling to Settings.
    local function overPopup(point)
        if not popup or not popup.Visible then return false end
        local p,s=popup.AbsolutePosition,popup.AbsoluteSize
        local v,vs=nativeHost.AbsolutePosition,nativeHost.AbsoluteSize
        return point.X>=math.max(p.X,v.X) and point.X<=math.min(p.X+s.X,v.X+vs.X)
            and point.Y>=math.max(p.Y,v.Y) and point.Y<=math.min(p.Y+s.Y,v.Y+vs.Y)
    end
    local lastWheelTime=0
    local function wheelInput(input)
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
            -- A parent and its child may observe the same wheel event.
            local now=os.clock()
            if now-lastWheelTime<.005 then return end
            lastWheelTime=now
            scrollSettings(-input.Position.Z*60*nativeScale(scroller))
        end
    end
    bindNative(popup.InputChanged,wheelInput)
    for _,row in ipairs(nativeRows) do bindNative(row.InputChanged,wheelInput) end
    local touch,startY,lastY,dragging
    bindNative(UIS.InputBegan,function(input)
        if input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape then closePopup() end
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch and overPopup(input.Position) then
            touch=input;startY=input.Position.Y;lastY=startY;dragging=false
        end
    end)
    bindNative(UIS.InputChanged,function(input)
        if input==touch then
            local y=input.Position.Y
            if math.abs(y-startY)>8 then dragging=true end
            if dragging then
                suppressSkinActivationUntil=os.clock()+.3
                scrollSettings(lastY-y)
            end
            lastY=y
        end
    end)
    bindNative(UIS.InputEnded,function(input)
        if input==touch then
            if dragging then suppressSkinActivationUntil=os.clock()+.3 end
            touch=nil;dragging=false
        end
    end)
    local function watchGameLabel(label)
        if label.Name~="Text" or not label:IsA("TextLabel") then return end
        for _,property in ipairs({"Text","TextColor3","FontFace","RichText"}) do
            bindNative(label:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property),function() setSelection(true) end)
        end
    end
    local gameLabel=original:FindFirstChild("Text")
    if gameLabel then watchGameLabel(gameLabel) end
    bindNative(original.ChildAdded,function(child) watchGameLabel(child);setSelection(true) end)
    bindNative(original:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"),function() setSelection(true) end)
    setSelection(true)
end
connect(game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped,updatePopupLayout)

task.spawn(function()
    while alive do
        local original=locateNative()
        if original and original:IsA("GuiButton") and (original~=nativeOriginal or not nativeButton or not nativeButton.Parent) then
            local ok,err=pcall(installNative,original)
            if not ok then disconnectNative();warn("Diplex Settings: "..tostring(err)) end
        elseif nativeOriginal and not nativeOriginal.Parent then disconnectNative() end
        task.wait(1)
    end
end)

local controller={}
function controller.Destroy()
    if not alive then return end
    alive=false;generation=generation+1;nativeCleanup();restore()
    for _,c in ipairs(connections) do c:Disconnect() end
    for _,model in pairs(cache) do model:Destroy() end
    gui:Destroy()
    if env.DiplexBaseSkinController==controller then env.DiplexBaseSkinController=nil end
end
env.DiplexBaseSkinController=controller
connect(gui.Destroying,function() if alive then controller.Destroy() end end)
task.spawn(function()
    while alive do
        task.wait(1)
        if active and (not active.Parent or not activePlot or not activePlot.Parent) then
            restore();_selectedSkin=nil;onSkinChanged(nil);SetStatus("Base changed. Select your skin again.")
        end
        if alive and active and activePlot and activePlot.Parent then reconcileHiddenParts(activePlot) end
        if alive then setSelection() end
    end
end)
